text:
Which description of the structure of an atom is correct?
A
a negatively charged nucleus with negatively charged electrons around it
B
a negatively charged nucleus with positively charged electrons around it
C
a positively charged nucleus with negatively charged electrons around it
D
a positively charged nucleus with positively charged electrons around it

options.label: A
options.text: a negatively charged nucleus with negatively charged electrons around it

options.label: B
options.text: a negatively charged nucleus with positively charged electrons around it

options.label: C
options.text: a positively charged nucleus with negatively charged electrons around it

options.label: D
options.text: a positively charged nucleus with positively charged electrons around it

subject: Physics
